items.desc: 🎢 Chessington World of Adventures tips you’ll want to know! 🦁 We went during the 6-week holidays and it was VERY busy, so here are a few things I wish I knew beforehand 👇 PARKING: We parked in Giraffe Car Park, which is a 5-minute walk to the entrance, so this was really convenient. TICKETS: I paid around £32 through GetYourGuide for my ticket. GetYourGuide is a platform where you can discover and book experiences and activities. BEST TIME TO GO: I’d recommend going outside school holidays if you can. If you have to go during the holidays, get there for opening and head straight to the rides you really want to do. PAW PATROL TIP: If you have younger children, definitely allow extra time for this area we went back later and queued around an hour for The Chase, but it was worth it! There are also shows and performances throughout the day, so check the timings when you arrive and plan around them.
